title: Nucleobase Specific Understanding about the Interaction of Antimalarial Drug Chloroquine with Duplex DNA.
authors: Bisoi, Asim; Sarkar, Sunipa; Lai, Tithi; Singh, Prashant Chandra
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文结合光谱实验与分子动力学模拟研究抗疟药氯喹与不同序列双链DNA的碱基特异性结合及沟槽偏好，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的药物-DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Antimalarial action of a drug is closely associated with the interaction with the parasite's DNA. Hence, in this study, the interaction of an important antimalarial drug, chloroquine (CLQ), has been investigated with six different sequences of DNA having pure adenine (A)-thymine (T) and pure cytosine (C)-guanine (G) as well as mixed nucleobases to achieve the nucleobase level of information in the binding of antimalarial drug with DNA along with binding induced stabilization/destabilization of DNA using different spectroscopic methods and molecular dynamics simulation technique. Further, the experiments have been also performed with 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline (7CLQ), an analogue of CLQ, to understand the role of the quinoline ring and side chain of CLQ in the binding with different sequences of DNA. The binding efficiency of CLQ with any sequence of DNA is higher than 7CLQ suggesting that the presence of charge on CLQ plays a prominent role in DNA binding. The data suggest that the binding of drug as well as induced stabilization of DNA depends significantly on the nature as well as the arrangement of the nucleobases. In general, the binding of CLQ with pure CG DNA is higher than with pure AT DNA; moreover, it prefers an alternate order of CG/AT than continual nucleobases in duplex DNA. CLQ predominately accommodates in the minor groove of AT DNA and prefers to form hydrogen bond mostly with the adenine nucleobase. In contrast to AT DNA, CLQ intrudes into the both major and minor grooves, but it is primarily accommodated into the major groove of CG DNA. CLQ forms a hydrogen bond mainly with guanine in the major groove and cytosine in the minor groove of CG DNA which enhances the binding of CLQ compared to AT DNA as well as induces higher stabilization in CG DNA. The molecular level information obtained about the functional group responsible for the interaction of CLQ as well as the role of chemical nature of nucleobases along with its ordering on the binding of CLQ with DNA may be useful in comprehensive understanding of its action mechanism.
abstract_zh: 药物的抗疟作用与其与寄生虫DNA的相互作用密切相关。因此，本研究采用不同的光谱方法和分子动力学模拟技术，考察了重要抗疟药物氯喹（CLQ）与六种不同序列DNA的相互作用，这些序列包括纯腺嘌呤（A）-胸腺嘧啶（T）、纯胞嘧啶（C）-鸟嘌呤（G）以及混合核碱基，以获取抗疟药物与DNA结合时核碱基水平的信息，以及结合诱导的DNA稳定化/去稳定化效应。此外，实验还使用CLQ的类似物4-氨基-7-氯喹啉（7CLQ）进行，以理解喹啉环和CLQ侧链在与不同序列DNA结合中的作用。CLQ与任何序列DNA的结合效率均高于7CLQ，表明CLQ上的电荷在DNA结合中起重要作用。数据表明，药物结合及诱导的DNA稳定化显著依赖于核碱基的性质和排列方式。总体而言，CLQ与纯CG DNA的结合高于纯AT DNA；此外，它更倾向于与双链DNA中交替排列的CG/AT序列结合，而非连续核碱基序列。CLQ主要嵌入AT DNA的小沟，并优先与腺嘌呤核碱基形成氢键。与AT DNA相反，CLQ侵入大沟和小沟，但主要嵌入CG DNA的大沟。CLQ在CG DNA的大沟中主要与鸟嘌呤形成氢键，在小沟中与胞嘧啶形成氢键，这增强了CLQ与CG DNA的结合，并诱导更高的稳定化。关于CLQ相互作用功能基团以及核碱基化学性质及其排列顺序在CLQ与DNA结合中作用的分子水平信息，可能有助于全面理解其作用机制。
